name: Lucky Crew

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 get 2x or 3x multipliers.

features.name: Steering-wheel spins
features.description: The ship's wheel sets the number of free spins.

review:
A 20-line pirate game where the Jolly Roger's crossed bones are wild multipliers. Wilds land on reels 2, 3 and 4 and randomly get a 2x or 3x, which applies to every line they're on.

Three compass scatters trigger free spins – but first, the captain spins the ship's wheel to decide how many you get. Very high volatility, 3,525x max and 95.98% RTP. Same setup as Penny Pelican.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
